data.narrative:
Dominion Dynamics is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Eliot Pence (former Anduril International leader, 2018-2022) and Mitch Carkner (ex-CEO Decisive, Amazon/IBM veteran, Canadian Forces background). The company has raised $18M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private operators including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods triangulate a credible range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $45M based on $18M raised as a proxy base. Peer-median methodology references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A), establishing a $400M median with a $125M–$1.0B range.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $38M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $222M across the two methods. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around peer applicability and stage positioning. UFORCE's $1.0B Seed valuation materially elevates the peer median; excluding it would compress the range significantly. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, technology differentiation relative to Anduril (Pence's prior employer), and defensibility of customer acquisition in an increasingly crowded defense-tech landscape.
